auth.banner: Organization, staff records, plans and results, devices and statistics in one place.
auth.enter_credentials: Enter your user name and password
auth.forgot_hint: Forgot your password? Ask the system administrator to reset it.
auth.bad_credentials_left: Wrong user name or password. {left} more failed attempt(s) will lock the account
auth.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the system administrator
auth.account_locked: Too many wrong passwords. The account is locked; try again in {minutes} minute(s) or ask the administrator to unlock it
auth.ip_blocked: Too many failed sign-ins from this computer. Try again in {minutes} minute(s)
auth.must_change_password: This is a temporary password. Set your own new password first
auth.password_rule: At least {min} characters, with both letters and digits, not the same as the user name
auth.password_other_sessions: After the change, your sign-ins on other computers or browsers end.
auth.password_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
auth.old_password_wrong: The current password is not correct
auth.password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters
auth.password_letters_digits: The password must contain both letters and digits
auth.password_is_username: The password cannot be the same as the user name
auth.password_same: The new password must differ from the current one
user.field.name: Name
user.person_hint: When linked, the name and department come from the staff record and the data scope follows that department
user.display_name_hint: Required when no staff record is linked
user.username_hint: 3–50 letters, digits or _ . - @; cannot be changed later
user.reset_confirm: A new temporary password will be created for “{name}” and all their sign-ins end now. Continue?
user.temp_password_note: It is shown only once. Give it to the person directly or through a trusted channel. They must change it at the first sign-in.
user.force_logout_confirm: All sign-ins of “{name}” end now and they must sign in again. Continue?
user.delete_confirm: Delete user “{name}”? They can no longer sign in; the activity history is kept.
user.err.username_taken: This user name is already in use
user.err.role_not_allowed: You cannot assign this role (only roles not above your own)
user.err.person_not_found: The staff record does not exist or is outside your scope
user.err.person_has_account: This person already has a user account
user.err.self_role_status: You cannot change your own role or disable yourself
user.err.self_logout: You cannot sign yourself out everywhere; use Sign out
user.err.self_delete: You cannot delete your own account
role.perms_saved: Permissions saved; they apply at the users' next action
role.super_note: The super admin has every permission; it cannot be changed or deleted.
role.sensitive_note: “Sensitive” covers full ID numbers and family records and must be granted on purpose. Technical functions (roles, settings, logs) belong to the super admin only.
role.staff_note: Staff records: “Add” = add people; “Delete” = remove people (left, retired, moved out; the record is kept). The default scope decides whom: a department-scope role works only inside its own department; a whole-unit role can also transfer and permanently delete records.
role.api_note: Menus follow the “View” permission; every API checks these permissions on the server, not just by hiding buttons. One role per user, plus the optional device-admin duty.
role.field.name: Role name
role.template_hint: You can adjust them in the permission table afterwards
role.builtin_name_fixed: Built-in role names cannot be changed
role.err.super_locked: The super admin's permissions cannot be changed
role.err.in_use: {n} user(s) still have this role: {names}. Give them another role in Users first.
settings.default_language_hint: Used by the sign-in page and by users who have not chosen a language; only enabled languages can be chosen
settings.err.language_disabled: Only an enabled language can be the default
log.reason.ip_limit: Too many failures from this IP
log.action.admin_created_cli: Super admin created from the command line
